title: the-hollow-reverts-a-commons-file-in-a-commons-worktree
intention: cairn test --hollow measures a CairnCommons file a ticket's writes_to names: it reverts the file in a worktree of the commons, linked beside the repo's scratch worktree under the name every reader spells, to the commons repo's own pre-build commit, instead of skipping it as 'not a path in this repo'.
why: Akien answered open-90d38cb2bdca ("a agreed", 2026-10-04): a build whose writes_to names CairnCommons files is proved like code, so the hollow must revert those files too. Until now every commons path is skipped as 'not a path in this repo', so a commons-only code-seam build (5f217a2d4bd6, three node_classes edits) reads 'every writes_to file was skipped' — a red no build can clear, and the lived symptom is that a real fix to how tickets are sent back to FIXME cannot reach PROVED.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass) — a commons-only code-seam build (5f217a2d4bd6) cannot reach PROVED while every commons file is skipped; Akien's answer to open-90d38cb2bdca; RULE 1 (the change and its proof stay inside cairn/devices/tester)
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py: split writes_to into repo files and commons files (_commons_rel: an absolute path under the commons, or 'CairnCommons/<rel>' / '../CairnCommons/<rel>'); anchor the commons files with the same build_anchor asked of the commons repo; when the ticket names a commons file, make scratch_worktree(commons HEAD, repo_root=commons) and symlink it at <worktree>.parent/CairnCommons, so repo-relative readers (transitions._NODE_CLASSES, address._COMMONS) read it; revert/restore each commons file in that worktree, key it 'CairnCommons/<rel>' in the finding; a commons that is not a git repository links the standing commons beside and skips its files with that reason. The finding gains commons_commit, commons_anchor_rule, commons_worktree. Proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_reverts_a_commons_file.py, written red (0/4 at HEAD).
falsifier: GREEN when test_the_hollow_reverts_a_commons_file.py passes all four teeth over a fixture repo with a git CairnCommons beside it whose build commit names the ticket: (1) the checked commons file is measured as 'CairnCommons/classes/x.json' and its declared tooth reds; (2) the unchecked commons file is measured and named hollow, not skipped; (3) commons_commit is the commons commit before the BUILDME crossing (rule journal) and differs from the repo's anchor; (4) a commons that is not a git repository is skipped with 'not a git repository', never 'not a path in this repo'; and the tester's other hollow proofs stay green. WRONG INTENT if a commons file's reversion cannot be seen by the proof through the beside path (the run reads the live commons), or if Akien rules commons builds are proved another way.
watchme: none, because the consumer that shows it worked is the next voyage: 5f217a2d4bd6's `cairn test --hollow` must measure its CairnCommons/node_classes files (ticket /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/5f217a2d4bd6-every-class-that-can-watch-can-be-sent-back-to-fixme.json), which is voyaged directly after this one
children: none, because the build is one function's change in one file of one component with one proof

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It changes only cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py: the docstring's refusal (2) is rewritten, two constants (SKIP_COMMONS_UNTRACKED, COMMONS_NAME/COMMONS_KEY) and two helpers (_commons_rel, _is_repo) are added, and measure() splits writes_to into repo files and commons files, anchors the commons files with build_anchor(ticket, cfiles, roots=roots, repo_root=commons), links a scratch_worktree of the commons HEAD at <worktree>.parent/CairnCommons when the ticket names a commons file, and reverts/restores each commons file there under the key 'CairnCommons/<rel>'. The finding gains commons_commit, commons_worktree and commons_anchor_rule.

D2: SETTLED: after D1 run `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_reverts_a_commons_file.py` (exit 0, 4 teeth green; it is red 0/4 at the build's parent), then each of the tester's regression proofs — `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow_follows_a_move.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow_anchors_before_the_build_that_stands.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_measures_at_the_seals_depth.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_an_unseen_revert_notifies_the_operator.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_hollow_seal_is_announced.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cli.py`, `python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py` — each must exit 0. A non-zero exit is a FIXME, never a skip.

D3: SETTLED: commit cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py alone with message 'b312ff041558: the hollow reverts a commons file in a commons worktree' (the proof was committed red before BUILDME). No other component changes (RULE 1).

D4: SETTLED: scope. Commons record files (tickets/) are not added to the skip list — a reverted ticket file reads hollow and notifies under the unvouched-green ruling (open-ed0a56ce6357). A hollow run whose ticket names no commons file gets no commons worktree and reads exactly what it read before. The broader 'no commons beside any hollow worktree' class, and readers that spell the home commons absolutely, are out of scope.

D5: SETTLED: the proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_reverts_a_commons_file.py is a red-first prerequisite: it is written and committed BEFORE the BUILDME crossing (red 0/4 at the build's parent), so the builder finds it at HEAD; the eleven regression proofs named in D2 already exist at HEAD under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/ (measured 2026-10-05: each ran with the build and exited 0). Each is run as 'python3 <path>' from the cairn repo root; no proof needs to be written at build time.
